original_target.title: Competitive exclusion with unequal death rates

scope_comparison: The live Durrett section3.1 after Theorem3.1.2 explicitly asks whether the birth/death ratio criterion suffices when death rates differ. The proved theorem and its graphical construction require equal death rates. The Stover stochastic-comparison announcement gives a sufficient restricted survival condition, not arbitrary-ratio competitive exclusion and the full iid-initial-law limiting distribution.
